newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Eastern Airline shrs seen in HK$1.24-HK$1.39 range.
newsitem.headline: Eastern Airline shrs seen in HK$1.24-HK$1.39 range.

text.p: China Eastern Airlines Corp Ltd is expected to issue its H-shares in a price range of HK$1.24 to HK$1.39 each in Hong Kong, representing a price to earnings multiple of 9.7 to 10.7 times, market sources said on Monday.

China Eastern Airlines is expected to issue about 140 million H-shares in the Hong Kong flotation, representing 10 percent of its global offering of about 1.4 billion H-shares, sources said. About 90 percent of the issue is expected to be for international placement.
H-shares are shares of Chinese enterprises listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange.
Sources said the China-based airline is expected to raise about US$200 million through a dual listing in New York and Hong Kong.
The Hong Kong flotation is expected to kick off later this month following its road show in the United States, Europe and in other Asian countries, sources said.
Dealing in shares is expected to begin in early February in Hong Kong, they said. Morgan Stanley is expected to be the sponsor of the issue.

Last Friday, China Eastern Airlines said it had filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell 12.6 million American Depositary Shares (ADS), of which half will be offered in the United States and Canada and half in the Asia Pacific region and Europe.
The company said it expected to sell its ADS at US$16 to US$18 each. The ADS issue represents 1.26 billion H-shares of the airline.
